column3: Close to the Hebrew; “you have struck your palms” is rendered “you have shaken hands in pledge.”
Close to the Hebrew; וּרְהַב (“press, pester”) is rendered “Plead with.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “of the hunter.”
Close to the Hebrew; כִמְהַלֵּךְ (“like a vagabond”) is rendered “like a prowler,” and “a man of shield” “an armed man.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a man of Belial” is rendered “A worthless person.”
Close to the Hebrew; מֹלֵל (“scrapes, signals”) is rendered “He shuffles.”
The first line is difficult; NKJV renders “For by means of a harlot A man is reduced to a crust of bread,” and “a man’s wife” “an adulteress.”
Close to the Hebrew; “to fill his soul” is rendered “to satisfy himself.”
